title: Sega Ages: Rouka ni Ichidanto R
native_title: セガエイジス 廊下にイチダントアール
overview:
Once again, a compilation of mini-games teams up with a quiz! Use your brains and reflexes and take on the challenge!

This Sega Ages volume brings two Sega arcade games together on one disc.

In Puzzle & Action: Ichidant-R, the detective duo returns as knights in a medieval stage play. Work through rounds of quick mini-games - timed button presses, memorizing and repeating sequences, and picking the right answer from the wrong ones - and jump to pop balloons in the bonus stages. Mistakes and running out of time cost lives.

Quiz Rouka ni Tattenasai! is a multiple-choice quiz where you pick a category, such as study, goods, baseball or entertainment and music, then choose the right answer from four options.

- Two games on one disc
- Up to 4 players at once with the Multi Terminal 6

再びミニゲームの集大成とクイズがドッキング!
頭脳と反射神経を駆使して挑戦を受けてみよ!
